tasks.title: Add Lalin document root parser
tasks.detail: Create the new .lln document parser/root materializer. It must lex whole source as Lalin, parse only root-role declaration-stream items under role display Lalin.decls, reject Lua chunk constructs (`local`, `return`, parse-time `import`, `module`) with hard-yank messages, accept top-level `[ ... ]` HostEval splices, and produce a `DeclDocument` AST plus ordered parsed declarations. Materialization must be sequential: merge the default Lalin host env with opts.env, bind each named parsed/generated decl into the document host env before resolving following HostEvals, resolve HostEval values with that env, flatten root splices through the Lalin decls adapter, and preserve bracket/source origins.
tasks.evidence: Created `lua/lalin/syntax/document.lua` with DeclDocument parser/materializer. Verified direct parser/materializer with `luajit -e` root struct/fn document, top-level `[gen]` declaration splice with later `[Generated]` type reference via opts.env, and hard-yank `local` rejection message.

tasks.title: Expose document parsing through lalin.syntax
tasks.detail: Require the new document module, add public helpers such as `parse_document`, `materialize_document`, and `load_document`/`to_decls`, and make `to_module` accept either a plain decl array or a `DeclDocument`/document result by routing through `to_tree.decls`. Keep existing `parse_entry`, `parse_expression`, and mixed-source registration intact for `.lua`/tooling syntax islands.
tasks.evidence: Updated `lua/lalin/syntax/init.lua`: requires `lalin.syntax.document`, exposes `parse_document`, `materialize_document`, `load_document`, and `to_decls`, and routes `to_module` through `LalinSyntax.to_decls`. Verified with `luajit -e` that `syntax.load_document` returns decls/DeclDocument and `syntax.to_module(doc, "X")` succeeds.

tasks.title: Teach role adapter DeclDocument decl collection
tasks.detail: Update `Adapter:decls` so a `DeclDocument` wrapper or document result with `body`/`decls` is treated as the declaration stream under role `decls`. Do not loosen arbitrary keyed-table policy for .lln documents; keyed table support remains only for Lua-built API values at compile boundaries.
tasks.evidence: Updated `lua/lalin/syntax/role_adapter.lua` so `Adapter:decls` unwraps `DeclDocument` via `decls` or `body` and recursively flattens HostEval/Fragment/document items in declaration streams. Verified with `luajit -e` parsing a DeclDocument and collecting it through `to_tree.decls(doc)`.

tasks.title: Replace lalin.loader value chunks with document loading
tasks.detail: Hard-yank the old call to `llbl.syntax.loadstring`. `Loader.loadstring` should call `lalin.syntax.load_document` and return `(decls, document)` or `(nil, err)`, not a Lua chunk. `loadfile` reads and delegates. `dofile` returns decls directly. `loadmodule` returns document decls plus path. `require` caches and returns decl arrays. `searcher` returns a Lua require loader function that returns the already-parsed decl array. Keep path/searcher plumbing and default host env merging, but remove `allow_import`/Lua chunk option semantics from the .lln path.
tasks.evidence: Rewrote `lua/lalin/loader.lua` so `.lln` loading uses `lalin.syntax.load_document` instead of `llbl.syntax.loadstring`: `loadstring`/`loadfile` return decls plus document metadata, `dofile` returns decls, `loadmodule` returns decls/path, `require` caches decl arrays, and `searcher` returns a loader that returns parsed decls. Verified direct loader loadstring success and hard-yank `return` rejection with `luajit -e`.

tasks.title: Update public lalin facade load APIs
tasks.detail: Change top comments and hosted-loading functions to document semantics. `M.loadstring`/`loadfile` return parsed declaration arrays, `M.dofile` returns the parsed document decls, `M.eval`/`M.load` must no longer execute returned chunks and should either alias document loading or be renamed in comments as document parsing. Ensure `module_ast_from` still compiles parsed document arrays and Lua builder values, while not implying .lln files may return arbitrary Lua tables.
tasks.evidence: Updated `lua/lalin/init.lua` public comments and hosted loading API: `loadstring`/`loadfile` parse documents and return decl arrays, `dofile` returns decls without calling a chunk, `eval` parses documents without executing chunks, and `M.load` aliases `M.loadstring`. Verified with `luajit -e` that `lalin.loadstring`/`lalin.eval` return decl arrays/document metadata and no callable chunk.

tasks.title: Update CLI .lln execution boundary
tasks.detail: For paths ending `.lln`, stop treating `lalin.loadstring` as a callable chunk. Parse the document, return success when parsing/materialization succeeds, and report parse/materialization errors. Leave `-e` and non-.lln files as ordinary Lua chunks so Lua builder workflows remain possible in `.lua`.
tasks.evidence: Updated `lua/lalin/cli.lua` .lln branch to parse documents via `lalin.loadstring` and return success/decls instead of calling a chunk; `-e` and non-.lln paths still use normal Lua chunks. Verified with `luajit -e` invoking `cli.main` on a temp `.lln` document (exit 0) and a `return {}` `.lln` (exit 70 with document-root rejection).
